001: Have you already bought a ticket for the fall concert at the university?
Not yet, have you? I heard that a famous band will be performing this year.
Yes, that's why I want to go. Maybe we can go together?
Great idea! Let's buy tickets on Friday after classes.
Okay, I'll check the schedule then and text you.
Deal. I'll be waiting for your message.
002: Are you going to the fair that will be on the main square on Saturday?
Of course, I'm going. They say there will be different workshops and treats there.
I also want to try traditional pancakes. And what time are you planning to come?
I think around twelve o'clock, so I have time to see everything.
Then let's meet at the entrance to the park.
Okay, I'll be there at twelve.
003: Have you already signed up for the charity run that our department is organizing?
Yes, I signed up yesterday. Have you decided to participate?
I think so, but I need to find comfortable running shoes.
I can lend you mine if the size fits.
Really? That would be wonderful. Thank you so much!
You're welcome. Come by my place in the evening, and we'll check everything.
004: Did you see the announcement about the foreign languages evening on Friday?
Yes, I saw it. I even want to perform there with a short poem.
Sounds great! And in what language will you read it?
In Spanish. I learned it in school and still remember it.
I'm sure you'll do great. I'll come to support you.
Thanks, that means a lot to me. I hope I don't forget the words.
005: Are you helping with the preparations for the student festival next month?
Yes, I'm on the hall decoration committee. And what are you doing?
I'm in charge of the music and inviting the DJ.
That's a big responsibility. Have you found anyone yet?
Not yet, but I have a couple of acquaintances who play good music.
Great. If you need help, just ask me.
006: Are you going to the lecture on modern art on Thursday?
To be honest, I haven't decided yet. What have you heard about it?
They say the lecturer is very interesting and doesn't make it boring.
Then I guess it's worth going. What time does it start?
At six in the evening in the main building.
Okay, I'll try to come. Maybe we can meet at the entrance?
007: Have you already chosen which workshop you'll go to at the open house?
I'm thinking about photography. What about you?
I want to go to the cooking one, they'll be teaching how to make Italian pasta there.
Sounds tasty. Will the photography workshop be at the same time?
I don't know for sure, we need to check the schedule on the website.
Let's look at it together after classes.
008: Did you hear that there will be a chess tournament between departments on Saturday?
Yes, I heard. I even want to try participating.
Seriously? I didn't know you play chess.
I play a little, but not professionally. I just want to test my skills.
That's great! I'll come to cheer for you.
Thanks, I'll try not to let you down.
009: Have you already bought a gift for the professor for the department's anniversary?
Not yet, we're collecting money as a group. What do you think we should give?
Maybe a nice book or something for the office?
Good idea. I heard he loves classical literature.
Then let's suggest that at the group meeting.
Agreed. I think everyone will like that option.
010: Are you going on the museum tour that the university is organizing?
Yes, I signed up. Have you decided yet?
I also want to go, but I don't know if I'll make it after my class.
The tour starts at three o'clock, so you'll have time.
Great, then I'll sign up too. And who will be the guide?
They say they invited a famous historian from another city.
